Physicist Hal Puthoff joins the Joe Rogan Experience for episode 2314. Puthoff is a rare bridge figure: a credentialed scientist who ran early remote-viewing research for the CIA and later worked on government UFO programs. His career links several of the show's favorite mysteries.

He tells Rogan what the remote-viewing trials claimed to show and how officials judged them. The talk moves on to UFO study inside government and what Puthoff thinks the data supports. Listeners get a first-hand history of America's strangest research programs, from a man who helped run them and still defends parts of the record.
